items.claim: Jan Blachowicz is still retaining his movement skills based on recent training footage.
items.quote: Some way something about the way Yan moves still. I'm watching his Instagram throw. I'm like, man, I feel like he's still got it.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz will benefit from fighting in Europe due to proximity to Poland.
items.quote: And uh we're in Europe, too. You know, we're in Serbia. Maybe he's got a little more Polish power

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz represents a severe jump up in competition for Navajo Sterling compared to his previous opponents.
items.quote: Yamlhovichic is a serious jump up in competition from Iwan Coutaba.

items.claim: Navajo Sterling has a significant reach and physical frame advantage suited for the modern light heavyweight division.
items.quote: I see a lot of reach for Navajo Sterling. His frame is such a 2026 light heavyweight frame.

items.claim: Jan Blachowicz will no longer look like a physically large light heavyweight in this matchup.
items.quote: Blhovich used to be a big light heavyweight, but I don't think he's going to look like it on Saturday
